title: FIXFlux - MiFID II Regulator View (restricted)
description: Transaction-reporting fields per trade: buyer/seller LEI, trading capacity, CFI code. Restricted: never part of a public publication.

options.content:
**Restricted.** The regulator's side of each trade, in the style of an RTS 22 transaction report: **buyer/seller LEI** (ISO 17442), **trading capacity** (`DEAL` / `MTCH` / `AOTC`) and **CFI code** (ISO 10962). These fields must never be published: the public dashboard (*MiFID II Post-Trade Reporting*) reads `regulatory_reports_public`, which leaves them out.

Data comes from `regulatory_reports_restricted` through the `grafana_regulator` role, which can read that view and nothing else. Every LEI is synthetic (`SIMX00...`). Nothing is sent to an ARM or regulator.

panels.title: Reports missing an LEI (selected time range)
panels.description: INCOMPLETE reports whose reason names a missing buyer or seller LEI: the reference data to fix before these could be reported.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Missing LEI" FROM regulatory_reports_restricted WHERE $__timeFilter(reporting_timestamp) AND status = 'INCOMPLETE' AND status_reason LIKE '%no LEI%'
SELECT count(*) AS "Reportable" FROM regulatory_reports_restricted WHERE $__timeFilter(reporting_timestamp) AND status = 'REPORTABLE'

SELECT count(DISTINCT lei) AS "LEIs" FROM (SELECT buyer_lei AS lei, reporting_timestamp FROM regulatory_reports_restricted UNION ALL SELECT seller_lei, reporting_timestamp FROM regulatory_reports_restricted) parties WHERE lei IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(reporting_timestamp)

panels.title: Regulator view per trade (latest 200)
panels.description: From the regulatory_reports_restricted view via the read-only grafana_regulator role. Parties are identified by LEI, as in a transaction report; internal client IDs appear only inside INCOMPLETE reasons.

targets.rawSql: SELECT trading_timestamp AS "Traded", trade_id AS "Trade ID", symbol AS "Symbol", cfi_code AS "CFI", price AS "Price", price_currency AS "Ccy", quantity AS "Qty", buyer_lei AS "Buyer LEI", buyer_trading_capacity AS "Buyer cap.", seller_lei AS "Seller LEI", seller_trading_capacity AS "Seller cap.", status AS "Status", status_reason AS "Reason", publication_latency_ms AS "Latency (ms)", deadline_breached AS "> 60s" FROM regulatory_reports_restricted WHERE $__timeFilter(reporting_timestamp) ORDER BY reporting_timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
